name: CollideFriend allies only
description: missiles.txt CollideFriend: 0 = enemies only (unchanged), 1 = allies only, 2+ = allies and enemies (old behaviour). Server and client.

patches.description: Server collision filter: move the no-owner accept path to the new accept block
Server collision filter: accept only when hostility differs from CollideFriend
Server collision handler: reject when hostility equals CollideFriend
Client collision filter: move the no-owner accept path to the new accept block
Client collision filter: accept only when hostility differs from CollideFriend
Client collision handler: reject when hostility equals CollideFriend
